title: Launch Agent 7's mandate is to bridge sophisticated capital and high-quality borrowers through structured credit infrastructure
content:
A.6.1.1.8.1 defines Launch Agent 7 as "an Agent focused on building structured credit infrastructure across traditional and digital financial markets."

Two distinct functions are bundled into one mandate. First, direct balance-sheet activity: "originating and managing institutional-grade credit facilities." Second, intermediation: serving "as a bridge between sophisticated capital and high-quality borrowers—including large enterprises and leading fintech platforms—through a suite of scalable credit solutions."

The stated objective is "durable liquidity and long-term growth" rather than yield maximization, which is what makes the mandate legible as an alignment constraint and not just a business description. An Agent whose purpose is durability has a defensible reason to decline profitable-but-fragile credit, and that reason is written into the Artifact rather than left to management discretion.

The cross-market framing (traditional *and* digital) is also load-bearing: it is the justification for the Agent needing both real-world credit machinery and on-chain Sky Primitives, and therefore for the operational complexity that fills the rest of the Artifact.
description: Scope spans both traditional and digital markets, and combines two roles: originating/managing institutional-grade credit facilities, and intermediating between capital and borrowers.
